method: For each original input subtile J of k coordinates, each token-output pair must collect a partial unscaled dot and multiply its scale/orbit factor then accumulate. Even if all requested dots were precomputed, the scheme needs T*H*(D/k) contributions (absent a more radical fused/reduced formulation). This is an output reconstruction work count, NOT an unavoidable separate global-memory read or lower bound on physical runtime; compilers can fuse, cache, aggregate, and transform the operator.

decision: k=2 has exact guaranteed duplicated projective codes but creates 4.52984832e9 per-token-output-subtile accumulation contributions at T128. A naive memoized scalar-dot lookup cannot be justified from collision count, and likely competes poorly against optimized FP4 GEMM; k>=8 reduces gathers but loses distribution-free collision guarantee. Look for substantial hardware-friendly shared tiles or an operator that avoids per-fragment gather entirely.
